name: OpenCanvas
description: Collaborative canvases in channels: notes, databases and whiteboards, edited live. Files are stored in Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Connect Mattermost to an OpenCanvas server. Register this server in OpenCanvas hosts.toml with the same host id, shared secret and API key (see the plugin README).

settings.help_text: The address people's browsers open, for example https://canvas.example.com.
Only if the Mattermost server reaches OpenCanvas at a different address. Leave empty otherwise.
Must match id in OpenCanvas hosts.toml.
At least 32 characters; the same value as jwt_secret in hosts.toml. Make one with openssl rand -hex 32.
Only if hosts.toml sets callback_secret. Leave empty otherwise.
Same as api_key in hosts.toml. Lets Mattermost close a canvas at once when someone leaves the channel.
What guest accounts can do in canvases of channels they are in: No access, View, Comment or Edit.
How long a link to open a canvas stays valid. 1 to 60; 10 is a good default.
